items.raw_excerpt: Two young tourists say they've never been more scared in their lives after 21-year-old Victorian woman Emma Hipwell was charged by a wild buffalo while holidaying in the Northern Territory.
items.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman from Victoria was charged by a wild buffalo while on holiday in the Northern Territory. She was tossed into the air and left bruised. She and her friends said it was the scariest moment of their lives.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주의 21세 여성이 북부 준주 여행 중 야생버펄로에게 공격받았다. 그녀는 공중으로 날려져 멍이 들었다. 그녀와 친구들은 인생에서 가장 무서운 순간이었다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Tourist tossed by wild buffalo in Australia
items.title_original: Tourist left bruised after being charged twice by wild buffalo

items.raw_excerpt: Despite challenges facing the wine industry - declining alcohol consumption and a global glut of grapes - wine company Delegat Group has reported strong sales results for 2026 which it expects to continue.
items.summary_en: Delegat Group, a New Zealand wine company, reported strong sales for 2026. The company expects growth to continue despite declining alcohol consumption and a global glut of grapes.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 와인 회사인 Delegat Group이 2026년 매출 호조를 보고했습니다. 알코올 소비 감소와 전 세계 포도 공급 과잉에도 불구하고 회사는 성장이 지속될 것으로 전망합니다.
items.title_en: NZ wine company posts strong sales despite headwinds
items.title_ko: 뉴질랜드 와인 회사, 업계 역풍 속에서도 매출 호조
items.title_original: Increased sales see wine group pouring back into business

items.raw_excerpt: Xaba says they are also on a campaign to educate residents on how to lodge disputes.
items.summary_en: The mayor of eThekwini is asking councillors to help fix billing issues. Residents are being taught how to file disputes over incorrect bills. This effort aims to improve city services for people in the area.
items.summary_ko: eThekwini 시장은 시의원들에게 요금 관련 문제 해결을 돕도록 요청하고 있습니다. 주민들에게 올바른 이의 제기 방법을 가르치는 캠페인도 진행 중입니다. 이번 조치는 지역 사회의 서비스 개선을 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: eThekwini Mayor urges councillors to help residents with billing disputes
items.title_ko: eThekwini 시장, 요금 문제 해결 위해 의원 협조 촉구
items.title_original: eThekwini Mayor urges councillors to help tackle billing issues

items.raw_excerpt: Mining company Sibanye-Stillwater hopes to have the Mt Lyell copper mine near Queenstown back up and running in 2029, creating 300 jobs in the process.
items.summary_en: Sibanye-Stillwater plans to reopen the Mount Lyell copper mine near Queenstown in 2029. The project is expected to create 300 jobs for the region.
items.summary_ko: 시반예-스틸워터가 퀸스타운 근처 마운트 라일 구리 광산을 2029년 재가동할 계획이다. 해당 프로젝트로 지역에 300개의 일자리가 생길 전망이다.
items.title_en: Tasmania copper mine to reopen in 2029
items.title_original: Breaking: Tasmania's Mount Lyell copper mine to reopen in boost for west coast

items.raw_excerpt: An investigation by the Data Protection Commission into the storage of paper records by the HSE has found incidents of documents contaminated by animal droppings, destroyed by mould, covered in rubble, or rotting due to water damage.
items.summary_en: Ireland's Data Protection Commission fined the Health Service Executive 645,000 euros. Investigators found paper records covered in animal droppings, mould, rubble, and water damage.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 데이터보호위원회가 보건서비스공단에 64만5000유로의 과징금을 부과했습니다. 조사 결과 종이 기록이 동물 배설물, 곰팡이, 잔해, 수분 피해로 훼손된 사실이 드러났습니다.
items.title_en: Health service fined over dirty records
items.title_original: HSE fined €645k over records covered in animal droppings
